group.title: Travel reimbursement reminder
group.passage:
To all travelling staff,

Please submit your expense report within ten days of returning from a business trip. Each claim must be [143] ____ by a receipt that shows the date, amount, and business name.

If a receipt is missing, complete the missing-receipt form and explain the expense. Approval is not automatic; the finance team may request [144] ____ information. [145] ____

To avoid delays, check that the total on your report matches the attached documents. Claims with missing details will be returned for correction rather than [146] ____ immediately.
group.passageZh:
各位出差同仁：

請在出差返回後十天內提交差旅費報銷單。每筆申請都必須以一張列有日期、金額及商家名稱的收據來 [143] ____。

若收據遺失，請填寫收據遺失表並說明費用。申請不會自動核准；財務團隊可能要求 [144] ____ 資訊。[145] ____

為避免延誤，請確認報銷單總額與附件相符。資料不全的報銷申請會退回更正，不會立即 [146] ____。
